1580-4871-5670-6094.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-6094.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6006-6791.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3652-6495.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-6495.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1329-2178-3652-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

851-4772-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-4772-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1671-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

3147-5256-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-1526-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-5434.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

206-222-527-2034.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-2034.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

777-3532-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

413-628-7200.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Reluctant Dounguard enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

997-6517-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

647-2366-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
647-2366-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1399-1606-1680-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and a land
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat

1978-4241-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Karn.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1922-2974.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Blur.
372-1922-2974.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Blur.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

3464-3657-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
3464-3657-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Selvala.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3464-3657-5457.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

1029-1129-5028.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
1029-1129-5028.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Harabaz Druid.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-1129-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1780-1912-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Burdened Aerialist.
When Burdened Aerialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

317-2292-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-2292-4186.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

618-914-1268.notablePrerequisites:
Crab Umbra attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
618-914-1268.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasures.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may instead create token copies of any other nonlegendary creature you control.

637-2452-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Archghoul of Thraben.
Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Archghoul of Thraben on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Archghoul of Thraben from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Archghoul of Thraben by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3229-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
3229-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Walk the Aeons on top of your library.
Activate Kefnet the Mindful by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

822-3088-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-3088-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-3088-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
